nubsNob.comments:
Snowmaking season has arrived! ❄️

The Snow Crew fired up the guns just before midnight last night. Overnight conditions weren't ideal, but the guns are still making snow this morning.

Unfortunately, there isn't enough cold air for a Thanksgiving Weekend opening. Even so, the Lodge, General Store, Tune Center, Cafeteria, Pub, and Locker Room will be open Friday and Saturday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.

We hope you'll stop by this weekend while we get ready for ski season. Catch the Michigan vs. Ohio State game in Nub's Pub on Saturday!

Think cold and snow
